decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program draws on the firm's existing production and logistics know-how for doors and gates, and its steady presence on the website suggests the firm understands it well and finds it useful.

The seventy-two-hour delivery stretches the firm's operations more than the fifteen-day program, but it still rests on established manufacturing knowledge, and its continued listing suggests the early results are acceptable.
Having its own page in both years shows that express delivery for doors and gates is a core offering built directly on the firm's main competencies.
The digital ordering platform is a strategic channel that lets the firm gather and learn from customer data, and its dedicated page shows ongoing commitment.

The fire and smoke protection door builds on deep knowledge of certified fire-protection products and was moved up to its own page in 2024, which suggests it likely took over the role of the withdrawn fire-resistant exterior door.
